name: ORBCore refund-before-sell reentrancy with pair-reserve burnLP
summary: ORBToken forwards BNB it receives to ORBCore.addPoolAndSell, whose sell branch refunds the BNB to the caller before selling, and _sellToken pays the caller before calling ORBToken.burnLP, which burns up to 20% of the pair's ORB and syncs; none of this is reentrancy-guarded and Core's own swaps are tax-free. With flash-loaned and Venus-borrowed WBNB the attacker first bought almost all ORB out of the ORB/WBNB pair, then re-entered at the refunds so that 58 nested sells ran their burnLP calls against the emptied reserve on the way out, grinding its ORB side to dust, and a final sell drained the pair's WBNB.

loss.notes: WBNB depletion of the ORB/WBNB pair 0x64fad72e5dde70b2960497744b348fd64cb4788c across the transaction (45.318191861188781185 -> 0.335708357864918575), less the attacker's pre-held 3,483.438204554125976510 ORB valued at the pre-exploit reserve ratio (0.027093460559344606 WBNB). Sell taxes routed to leader2 are not deducted; borrowed legs are repaid in-transaction and excluded.

ageReset.description: Direct immutable ORBCore; the owner's wiring within 1,101 blocks of deployment (setOther, addFilterSpecialAddressArr, setLpTo, setMinterAddress, setBNBLimit and ORBToken.setAddress(core), last at block 109761315) only made it operational, and minBNB, whiteListOpen and the sell/burn ratios read the same at 109761119 and 121296109.

limitations: ORBToken 0xc4d27261c06407053cad16cb825ecc0eee7ee7d7 (deployed earlier, block 109718211, runtime 0x437b1483ebe856784080bd939f5349ccf1e5faddf87dd03837371e231885b651) supplies the unguarded receive() forwarding and burnLP; it is the older artifact, so ORBCore's later deployment is the knot.

sources.note: Reviewed root cause, first exercise, artifact identity and age. Verified sources (Etherscan V2 getsourcecode chainid=56, v0.8.17+commit.8df45f5f, optimizer 200): ORBCore SHA-256 e547dddb4e069e141dcf0f0e8e9efd9100302081154c44c99ab31ef469d700d0, ORBToken eb5eec1a1a2ad4b563ec4ae9bb2e12363d4f72416d7336d39b1cc21dae623ff5. ORBCore.addPoolAndSell (onlyTokenAddress): for SELL_BNB_LOWEST <= msg.value < minBNB it first safeTransferETH(account, BNBValue), then _sellToken, which swaps the caller's ORB through the router, safeTransferETH(account, userBNB) and only then IToken.burnLP(sellTokenAmount * sellBurnTokenRatio / 10000); ORBToken.burnLP (onlyCoreAddress) burns from the pair when amount < pair balance / 5 and syncs. No function has a reentrancy guard. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) of source-1 (block 121296110, index 64, EOA 0xd8b49172b1a33e77c2619a78e08471facff5dad3 -> 0x4f33733a40fae6c19c3a4faf9bc08ce9a1806831): Moolah and Venus funded WBNB buys the pool's ORB through Core (_addPool path), the attack contract re-enters through ORBToken.receive() at each refund, and the receipt carries 58 AccountSell events; pair WBNB transfers net 896248.990050001200722372 in and 896293.495994033612676884 + 0.476539470911908098 out. First exercise: eth_getLogs on ORBCore from deployment to 121296110 returns 9,224 events, including 76 AccountSell (topic 0x4c4479f8...) in 19 transactions; source-1 is the only transaction with more than one, so no earlier reentrant sell occurred. Configuration: nonce bisection of owner 0x008471fab0a89cbd5c789501d2afc92985bdea17 between blocks 109718210 and 121296109 finds 24 transactions: token burnOwnership and addSafeAddresss, Core setOther (twice), addFilterSpecialAddressArr (6), setLpTo, setMinterAddress, setBNBLimit(0.01 BNB, ..., whiteListOpen=false) at 109761119 and ORBToken.setAddress(Core) at 109761315 (source-5), then only takeETH withdrawals, two everydayEarnArrPage runs, a timerDefl call and setSuperEarnRequireArr (114382966, referral tiers, not on the sell path). Artifact: eth_getCode(Core) 0x at 109760213; keccak256 0xb6272aafdf42763b12a403556b1ffa7d94d2e7e72509ee69e08ee477a7745f57 at 109760214 and 121296109; source-2 is its top-level creation (index 33) by the owner. No proxy or self-destruct path. Deployment supplies the age.
